title: Alt+drag a gallery card into another app (real OS file drag)
description: Dragging a gallery card to Explorer/Finder works, but dropping it into Discord, Photoshop or a browser upload zone does nothing. Root cause is not a bug: MPI-318 exports via Chromium's `DownloadURL`, which is a VIRTUAL-FILE PROMISE (CFSTR_FILEDESCRIPTOR). Explorer materializes it; third-party apps read CF_HDROP (a real path) and see nothing. Only fix is Electron `webContents.startDrag({files, icon})`, which REPLACES the HTML5 drag session -- so it can never share the plain-drag gesture with the in-app `application/mpi-media` drop (PromptBox chip, group-history). Second gesture required: hold ALT while dragging a card = native OS file drag. Plain drag is untouched. Alt+drag while in selection mode drags EVERY selected card's file (multi-file export, the thing DownloadURL could not do and that was dropped in MPI-318).
